app_tagline: Open-source incident management that deploys to your Cloudflare account.
overview_description: The dashboard, its Worker, the API Worker and a Durable Object, all running on your machine.
stack_api_down: The API Worker is not responding
stack_do_down: The Durable Object did not answer
stack_error_timeout: The request took longer than {seconds} seconds and was cancelled.
stack_error_invalid: The API answered, but not with the data the dashboard expects.
stack_hint_start: Start everything from the repository root, then check again:
stack_hint_do: The API is up. Look for the error in the terminal running:
legend_description: How incidents are marked across Brigade. The code or the name always travels with the colour.
stack_error_unreachable: The web Worker couldn't reach the API Worker.
stack_hint_api_error: The API answered with an error. Look for it in the terminal running:
stack_api_error: The API Worker is answering with errors
stack_api_stuck: The API Worker is not answering in time
stack_hint_api_stuck: The API looks like it is running but stuck. Look in the terminal running:
paging_unreachable: Couldn't check whether pages get through
paging_unknown: The paging self-check hasn't run yet. Once it runs, a heartbeat goes through Brigade's event queue every minute and checks that the push relay accepts Brigade's token. It doesn't send anything to phones.
paging_reason_pipeline_stalled: The self-check's heartbeat stopped getting through the event queue, or gets through minutes late.
paging_reason_pipeline_slow: The self-check's heartbeat takes more than two minutes to get through the event queue.
paging_reason_relay_unauthorized: The push relay refused Brigade's send token, so no page can go out.
paging_reason_relay_not_configured: No push relay is set up, so every page is recorded as failed.
mobile_overview_description: The severity and status legend, drawn from the shared tokens and catalog.
intl_description: What this JavaScript engine provides on its own, and what the shared helpers render with it.
sync_reconnecting_hint: Showing the last list received. Changes you make are sent once the connection is back.
sync_unavailable_hint: Couldn't connect to Brigade Sync. For now it only runs in the local stack, started from the repository root:
sync_retrying: This page keeps trying on its own.
sync_error_forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
sync_error_invalid_transition: Its status changed in the meantime, so that move is no longer allowed.
sync_error_invalid_args: Check what you typed and try again.
sync_error_expired: It waited too long to be sent and was dropped.
sync_error_too_many_pending: Wait for the pending changes to be sent, then try again.
sync_error_closed: This page stopped syncing. Reload it to try again.
sync_error_internal: Something went wrong on the server. Try again.
sync_error_limit_reached: You've reached the limit for this.
declare_title_invalid: A title needs visible text: invisible characters alone don't count.
sync_error_read_forbidden: You don't have access to these incidents.
sync_offline_hint: Can't reach Brigade right now. Changes you make are sent when the connection is back, as long as this page stays open.
sync_error_clock_skew: Your device clock is ahead of the server. Fix the date and time and try again.
declare_sent: Sent “{title}”. It shows here once the list loads.
mobile_sync_retrying: The app keeps trying on its own.
mobile_sync_offline_hint: Can't reach Brigade right now. Changes you make are sent when the connection is back, as long as the app stays open.

match.part=sign_in_hint: New to Brigade? Create an account on the dashboard, then sign in here.
match.part=no_server: This build doesn't say which Brigade to connect to.
match.part=no_workspace: Your account isn't in a workspace yet. Create one on the dashboard, then open Brigade again.
match.part=sign_out_body: This phone stops getting pages until you sign in again.
match.part=pages_off: Notifications are off. Turn them on in Settings to be paged here.
match.part=pages_failed: Couldn't register this phone. Brigade keeps trying.
match.part=pages_taken: This phone still pages the person signed in on it before you, who signed out without a connection. Brigade frees it for you once it can finish their sign-out.
match.part=assign_hint: Opens the members who can hold it
match.part=sign_out_body_unpaged: You'll need to sign in again to see incidents here.
match.part=sign_out_kept_title: This phone may still get pages for you
match.part=sign_out_kept_body: Brigade couldn't reach the server, so this phone keeps getting your pages until it's back online. Brigade finishes signing you out then, on its own.
match.part=sign_out_stuck_title: This phone may keep getting your pages
match.part=sign_out_stuck_body: Brigade couldn't reach the server, nor keep your session to finish signing you out later, so it can't free this phone on its own. To stop the pages, sign in here again with a connection and sign out.
match.part=incident_stale_hint: Showing this incident as last received. Changes you make are sent once the connection is back, as long as Brigade stays open.
match.part=update_waiting: Not sent yet. Keep Brigade open: it sends once Brigade is reachable again.

push_unavailable: Not available on this platform yet.
auth_sign_in_description: Use the email and password you signed up with.
auth_sign_up_description: You will own a new workspace. Invite your team once it is set up.
auth_error_email: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
auth_error_credentials: That email and password do not match an account.
auth_error_email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
auth_error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
auth_error_network: Could not reach Brigade. Check your connection and try again.
workspace_error_limit: You belong to as many workspaces as Brigade allows. Ask an owner to add you instead.
workspace_name_invalid: A name needs visible text: invisible characters alone don't count.
workspace_create_description: Incidents and the people who handle them live in a workspace.
auth_name_invalid: Remove invisible, control or bidi characters from the name.
call_script_prompt: Press 1 to acknowledge, or hang up to pass the page on.
call_no_incident: This page names no incident, so it can't be acknowledged here.
call_test_ringing: Lock the phone now: it rings in 10 seconds.
call_test_no_incident: Declare an incident first: the call acknowledges it.
monitors_empty: Nothing is watched yet. Add an HTTP check, a TCP port, or a heartbeat for jobs that should check in.
monitor_limit_reached: This workspace has {max} monitors, the most it can have. Delete one to add another.

match.action=prompt: Pause this monitor? Its checks stop until you resume it.
match.action=prompt_alert: Pause this monitor? Its checks stop until you resume it, and its firing alert resolves.

match.field=url: Use a public http or https address, on a web port such as 80, 443, 8080 or 8443.
match.field=host: Use a public host name or IP address, without http:// or a port.
match.field=host_cloudflare: Cloudflare doesn't allow TCP checks of its own addresses. Use your server's address.
match.field=host_underscore: Host names can't contain underscores (_). Use a public host name or IP address.
match.field=port_blocked: Cloudflare blocks port 25. Use another port.
match.field=expected_status: Use a status from 100 to 599, or leave it empty.
match.field=interval: Use whole seconds, from 30 to 86,400 (24 hours).
match.field=timeout: Use 1 to 30 seconds, and no more than the interval.
match.field=grace: Use whole seconds, from 0 to 86,400 (24 hours).

match.field=url: Everyone in the workspace, viewers too, can see this URL: keep tokens and passwords out of it.
match.field=expected_status: Empty: any 2xx or 3xx. Redirects are not followed.
match.field=host: Passes when a connection to this host and port opens; nothing is sent. Hosts proxied by Cloudflare can't be checked over TCP.
match.field=timeout: How long one check may take.
match.field=timeout_tcp: How long the connection may take to open.
match.field=*: How late a ping may be before it counts as missed.

match.part=send: Send a POST to this URL at least every {interval}. Brigade keeps only a hash of it, so it can't be shown again.
match.part=close_prompt: Close without copying? The URL can't be shown again.

match.part=restart: Saving starts its checks over: the last results are dropped and it shows Waiting until its regions report again.
match.part=restart_alert: Its firing alert stays until its checks pass again.

match.part=prompt: Delete {name}? Its checks stop and its results are gone for good.
match.part=alert: Its firing alert resolves. The incident it opened is left for people to close.
match.part=incidents: Incidents it opened before stay as they are.

match.part=not_found: There is no incident with this number in this workspace.
match.part=update_placeholder: What do you know now? What happens next?
match.part=update_hint: Everyone in the workspace sees it on the timeline.
match.part=update_invalid: Remove invisible, control or bidi characters and try again.
match.part=no_members: Teammates show up here once they have opened Brigade.
match.part=read_only: Viewers follow the incident; responders and admins change it.

match.kind=page_failed_undelivered: Couldn't page {a}: the push didn't go through
match.kind=page_failed_unsupported: Couldn't page {a}: Brigade can't push to Android phones yet
match.kind=page_failed_not_configured: Couldn't page {a}: push notifications aren't set up on this server
match.kind=page_failed_over_limit: Couldn't page {a}: this page went to too many phones
match.kind=page_nobody: Nobody was paged: no one who can respond has Brigade on their phone
match.kind=page_dead_lettered: A page may not have gone out: Brigade kept failing to send it
match.kind=page_failed_not_a_member: Couldn't page {a}: no longer someone who can respond
match.kind=page_schedule_missing: Couldn't page a schedule that was deleted
match.kind=escalated_timeout: Nobody acknowledged, so level {a} was paged: {b}
match.kind=escalated_unreachable: Earlier levels couldn't reach anyone, so level {a} was paged: {b}
match.kind=escalated_everyone: No level could reach anyone, so everyone who can respond was paged
match.kind=escalated_everyone_later: No later level could reach anyone, so everyone who can respond was paged
match.kind=escalated_again: Level {a} paged again: the earlier page was lost
match.kind=escalated_everyone_again: Everyone who can respond paged again: the earlier page was lost
match.kind=page_nobody_else: Nobody else was paged: only the person who declared it can respond
match.kind=escalation_exhausted: Nobody acknowledged after every level, so everyone who can respond was paged
match.kind=escalated_everyone_stalled: An escalation level kept failing to fire, so everyone who can respond was paged
match.kind=page_escalation_stalled: An escalation level couldn't fire. Brigade keeps trying, and pages everyone who can respond if it still can't

match.reason=no_devices, countPlural=one: Couldn't page {countFormatted} person: no registered device
match.reason=no_devices, countPlural=*: Couldn't page {countFormatted} people: no registered device
match.reason=undelivered, countPlural=one: Couldn't page {countFormatted} person: the push didn't go through
match.reason=undelivered, countPlural=*: Couldn't page {countFormatted} people: the push didn't go through
match.reason=unsupported, countPlural=one: Couldn't page {countFormatted} person: Brigade can't push to Android phones yet
match.reason=unsupported, countPlural=*: Couldn't page {countFormatted} people: Brigade can't push to Android phones yet
match.reason=not_configured, countPlural=one: Couldn't page {countFormatted} person: push notifications aren't set up on this server
match.reason=not_configured, countPlural=*: Couldn't page {countFormatted} people: push notifications aren't set up on this server
match.reason=over_limit, countPlural=one: Couldn't page {countFormatted} person: this page went to too many phones
match.reason=over_limit, countPlural=*: Couldn't page {countFormatted} people: this page went to too many phones
match.reason=not_a_member, countPlural=one: Couldn't page {countFormatted} person: no longer someone who can respond
match.reason=not_a_member, countPlural=*: Couldn't page {countFormatted} people: no longer someone who can respond

match.part=description: Owners and admins change roles and remove members. Someone removed stops being paged right away.
match.part=read_only: Only owners and admins change roles or remove members.
match.part=remove_prompt: Remove {name} from the workspace? They lose access and stop being paged right away.
match.part=leave_prompt: Leave this workspace? You lose access and stop being paged right away.
match.part=empty: Nobody else is in this workspace yet.
match.part=only_owner: You're the only owner. Make someone else an owner before you can leave or change your role.

match.reason=last_owner: A workspace needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
match.reason=not_found: This person is no longer a member.
match.reason=conflict: Someone else changed this member meanwhile. Check the list and try again.
match.reason=not_applied: Saved. Paging catches up on its own within a minute.
match.reason=unavailable: Brigade couldn't reach its database. Nothing changed; try again.
match.reason=network: Couldn't confirm the change; check the list.

match.kind=owner: Change your role to {role}? You can no longer manage owners; only an owner can give it back.
match.kind=all: Change your role to {role}? You can no longer manage members or owners; only an owner can give it back.
match.kind=*: Change your role to {role}? You can no longer manage members; only an owner or admin can give it back.

oncall_empty: No on-call schedules yet. A schedule says who is on call and when they hand off.
oncall_not_paging: Schedules page people through an escalation policy (below); without a default policy, pages go to the incident's commander, or to everyone who can respond.
oncall_upcoming_none: No handoffs in the next 4 weeks
oncall_layer_empty: Nobody in this layer: a gap until someone is added
oncall_layers_hint: Layers stack: a later layer wins where it has someone on call. Handoffs follow the time zone's clock, also across daylight saving changes.

match.field=name: Enter a name, up to 80 characters.
match.field=layer_name: Enter a layer name, up to 60 characters.
match.field=*: End after the start, in the future, at most 90 days later.

oncall_count_invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.
oncall_delete_confirm: Delete {name}? Its overrides are deleted with it.
oncall_override_self: You can add overrides for yourself.

match.state=hidden: Now: {name}, hidden by a later layer

match.text=dropped_members: People who can no longer be on call (viewers, or members who left) were taken out of the layers below. Save to keep the change.
match.text=*: A later layer has someone at all times from this layer's start, so nobody in this one is ever on call.

match.part=placeholder: Search a city or UTC offset

match.text=empty: No escalation policies yet. Without a default policy, pages go to the incident's commander, or to everyone who can respond.
match.text=no_default: No default policy: pages go to the incident's commander, or to everyone who can respond.
match.text=default_note: Every page, from a monitor or declared by hand, goes through the default policy.
match.text=level_empty: Nobody to page at this level: it is skipped until someone is added
match.text=delete_confirm: Delete {name}? Runs under way keep the levels they started with.
match.text=delete_default: It is the default: pages go back to the incident's commander, or to everyone who can respond.
match.text=dropped: People or schedules that are gone were taken out of this policy.
match.text=hint: Levels page in order until someone acknowledges. A schedule pages whoever is on call when its level fires; a level nobody can be reached at is skipped at once.
match.text=level_empty_draft: Nobody to page yet: add a schedule or a person, or remove this level.

match.kind=timeout_end, count=*, countPlural=o: Everyone who can respond after {countFormatted} minute
match.kind=timeout_end, count=*, countPlural=*: Everyone who can respond after {countFormatted} minutes

match.field=timeout_last, form=label: Minutes before paging everyone who can respond
match.field=add_target, form=label: Add a schedule or a person
match.field=timeout, form=invalid: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to 1440.
match.field=targets, form=invalid: Add at least one schedule or person.

match.part=fallback_unreachable: No level could reach anyone: paged everyone who can respond
match.part=fallback_exhausted: Nobody acknowledged after every level: paged everyone who can respond
match.part=fallback_stalled: A level kept failing to fire: paged everyone who can respond
match.part=fallback_unreachable_later: No later level could reach anyone: paged everyone who can respond
match.part=fallback_unreachable_nobody: No level could reach anyone. Tried everyone who can respond: nobody could be paged
match.part=fallback_unreachable_later_nobody: No later level could reach anyone. Tried everyone who can respond: nobody could be paged
match.part=fallback_exhausted_nobody: Nobody acknowledged after every level. Tried everyone who can respond: nobody could be paged
match.part=fallback_stalled_nobody: A level kept failing to fire. Tried everyone who can respond: nobody could be paged

match.part=hint: Stops paging: no further escalation level fires.
